talent_density.reason: Official employment statistics absent; indicator declared per announcement 1.5(2), computable after data release.

synthetic_negative_branch_count.formula: 15 services x 7 failure branches (missing_responsible_role / data_exceeds_declared_ceiling / same_task_human_route_unavailable / cannot_pause / revision_not_public / bequest_dividend_missing / post_exit_service_lapses) = 105 negative branches, all blocked (negative_blocked)
assumptions: 100% of failure branches intercepted: releasing any of the 105 would fail the whole rehearsal.

service_passport_required_field_count.formula: declared fields: service & location / target users / non-AI baseline / data ceiling / responsible role / operator / same-task human route / success evidence / failure signals / appeal & pause / retirement & recovery
assumptions: Passport gates every public AI service; a service without all 11 fields is not registered.

operational_evidence_gate_count.formula: declared gates E0-E4: register / baseline & rights / supervised pilot / independent re-test / continue or retire
assumptions: Gates map to P1-P4 phases; no service is released without passing E4 human decision.

first_100_days_action_count.formula: declared 8 steps D1-14 ... D91-100 in JZ-01 pilot table
assumptions: First 100 days: census baseline, public registration, pilot protocol, evidence collection, independent re-test, decision point.

same_task_equivalence_scenario_count.formula: 12 scenario cards each with declared same-task human / low-tech route and pre-release proof content
assumptions: Equivalence register: every AI service must prove a same-task non-AI route exists before release.

contract_coverage_ratio.formula: 15 public-AI services x 4 clauses (BASE non-AI baseline / BOOST AI gain and boundary / BLACKOUT stop arrangement / BEQUEST exit contract) = 15/15 contracts complete
assumptions: 100% contract coverage: a service without a bequest clause may not be released.

blackout_clause_coverage_ratio.formula: each contract has a blackout clause paired one-to-one with the five rollback triggers
assumptions: 100% of services have an arranged stop path and a same-task human route.

bequest_clause_coverage_ratio.formula: each contract has a bequest clause: retirement condition, data disposition, site restoration, archive
assumptions: 100% of services have a pre-declared exit; no service may remain in pilot indefinitely.

state_machine_state_count.formula: states: proposed / baseline_verified / sandboxed / live / blackout_drill / bequest_audit / retained_or_modified / removed_archived
assumptions: blackout_drill and bequest_audit are not skippable; removed_archived requires bequest_audit or hard stop.

state_machine_gate_count.formula: 8 documented transitions each carrying role_ids, gate_ids and conditions
assumptions: Every transition cites the service passport and evidence gates E0-E4 it depends on.

dual_gateway_gate_count.formula: project gates G0-G7 (no-go until authorized ... review and retirement) + scenario gates C0-C7 (card registration ... exit contract) = 16
assumptions: No gate may be replaced by calendar order; G0 blocks all un-authorized advancement.

governance_role_count.formula: roles: accountable lead / operations / safety / data / public-baseline steward / independent evaluator / maintenance / affected public
assumptions: Each role lists passport fields, responsible-for, must-not-impersonate and fallback-if-absent.

governance_constitutional_rule_count.formula: constitutional rules: single accountable lead / steward and safety may stop independently / no operator certifies its own bequest audit / affected public never burdened with professional liability / roles are concepts not authorities
assumptions: Constitutional rules bind the roles; they are proposal concepts, not current authorities.

simulation_rerun_receipt_ratio.formula: all 120 receipts re-derivable from (service_id, variant, seed) via node simulate-check.js with exit-code contract 0/1/2
assumptions: Reviewers can re-run the check offline; status is fixed as offline_complete_field_not_authorized_not_run.

review_evidence_dimension_count.formula: seven evaluation dimensions each indexed to openable sections and files (brief_alignment / originality / ai_planning_innovation / implementation_feasibility / public_interest_inclusion / risk_compliance / expression_completeness)
assumptions: Every review claim points to a machine-readable file or proposal section that can be opened.

issue_ledger_entry_count.formula: public issue ledger entries: #846 site-polygon vs railway park 412.5m mismatch, #1029 PROV-KEY-003 centroid offset at Dazhongsi, #1368 provisional-boundary review-ready semantics (see evidence chapter)
assumptions: Real open issues are registered and answered; omissions are disclosed rather than hidden.

evidence_level_declared_count.formula: evidence levels L1 (official documents) / L2 (public sources) / L3 (derived calculations) / L4 (concept suggestions) / L5 (provisional assumptions)
assumptions: Every claim carries an evidence level; L5 items never masquerade as official facts.
